summary.text: John Cate is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Merrimack 22, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026.

paragraphs.text: John Cate was the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Merrimack 24, in the November 8, 2022 general election, in which Matthew Hicks, a Democrat, defeated him.
